dialogue.origin: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: ご準備はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you ready to begin?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: I’m ready.

dialogue.origin: では、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Alright, let's get started.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 夫のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご主人のどんなところにお悩みですか？
dialogue.content: What specifically about your husband is troubling you?

dialogue.origin: 夫が浮気しているようなんです
dialogue.content: It seems my husband is having an affair.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですよね・・
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: それはいつ頃お気づきになったのですか？
dialogue.content: When did you first notice this?

dialogue.origin: 1月ほど前です
dialogue.content: About a month ago.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それはびっくりなさったでしょうね・・
dialogue.content: That must have been quite a shock...

dialogue.origin: 前から何回かあったので、ショックです
dialogue.content: This has happened several times before, and I'm still shocked.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それはそうですよね・・・
dialogue.content: I can certainly understand that...

dialogue.origin: 今回はどのように気づかれたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How did you notice it this time?

dialogue.origin: 様子がおかしいんですよ
dialogue.content: He's been acting strange.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 携帯を常に持ち歩いたりして。
dialogue.content: He's always carrying his phone with him, for example.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: それは気になりますよね
dialogue.content: That would certainly make you wonder.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 携帯を離さないのですね。それ以外にもなにか気になることはありますか？
dialogue.content: So he never lets his phone out of his sight. Is there anything else that's worrying you?

dialogue.origin: 普段、食事の準備や片付けはしない人なのに、急にやりだしたりしてます
dialogue.content: He normally doesn’t help with meal prep or cleanup, but suddenly he’s started doing it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 普段と違うことをされると気になりますよね
dialogue.content: It's concerning when he acts differently than usual, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 前にも同じようなことがあって、発覚したんです
dialogue.content: Something similar happened before, and that's when I found out.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: またかぁ、って感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like, “Here we go again.”

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今回も何となくそんな感じがするのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you have a feeling that it's the same situation this time?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。態度もよそよそしいので…
dialogue.content: Yes. He’s also been distant…

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 前回のことを考えると、そう思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Considering what happened last time, it's natural for you to think that.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: ずっと部屋にとじこもって、パソコンしたり携帯いじってりで会話もないです…
dialogue.content: He just shuts himself in his room, on his computer or fiddling with his phone, and we don't talk at all…

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・それは同じ家にいるのに寂しいですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must feel lonely, even though you're in the same house.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: お休みの日なども同じような感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it the same on his days off as well?

dialogue.origin: ずっとです。家にいるときはずっと携帯にぎりしめています。
dialogue.content: All the time. Whenever he's home, he's always clutching his phone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 一日中では、こちらも話かけづらいですよね
dialogue.content: If he's like that all day, it must be hard for you to talk to him.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけると怒りだすので、用事がないときは話さないようにしています
dialogue.content: He gets angry if I try to talk to him, so I try not to unless it's necessary.

dialogue.origin: 怒られるとこちらも話しかけづらいですよね
dialogue.content: It's hard to approach someone when they might get angry, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: お食事などはどのようにされていますか？
dialogue.content: How are your mealtimes?

dialogue.origin: 食事は基本一緒にたべます
dialogue.content: We usually eat together.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 食事中はご主人もお話されるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband talk during meals?

dialogue.origin: こちらが話しかけないとほとんど話さないです。味が口に合わないときだけ、文句をいいます。
dialogue.content: He hardly speaks unless I say something. The only time he does is to complain when he doesn't like the food.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それは余計話しかけづらくなりますよね
dialogue.content: That must make it even harder to talk to him.

dialogue.origin: はい。食事のときくらいはって思うんですが…
dialogue.content: Yes. I feel like we should at least talk during meals, but...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.origin: 食事中くらいは、話したいですよね
dialogue.content: You’d like to talk at least during meals, wouldn’t you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですよね
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: どうしていいかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 前回も、と仰っていましたが、その時と同じようなご主人の態度なのですよね・・
dialogue.content: You mentioned this happened before... Is your husband's attitude similar to how it was then?

dialogue.origin: 浮気のうたがいがあると、態度にあらわれるんです
dialogue.content: When he might be cheating, it really shows in his attitude.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 会話にかぎっては、さらに無口になるというか…
dialogue.content: When it comes to conversation, he becomes even more silent...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それは悲しくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: That must make you feel sad.

dialogue.origin: ご家族はほかにはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any other family members?

dialogue.origin: 子供が一人います
dialogue.content: We have one child.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今、おいくつでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How old is your child now?

dialogue.origin: 年長さんです
dialogue.content: They’re in their final year of kindergarten.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご主人とお子様のご関係はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What is your husband's relationship with your child like?

dialogue.origin: 夫は子どもには優しいです。よく遊んでいます
dialogue.content: My husband is kind to our child. He plays with them a lot.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 休日などはお子様とお出かけしたりされるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you go out together with your child on holidays?

dialogue.origin: 今はコロナの影響がありほとんどでかけてないですが、庭でボールや鬼ごっことかして遊んでくれます。
dialogue.content: We don't go out much now because of COVID, but he plays with them in the yard, with a ball or playing tag.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお子様とは遊んでくれるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so he does play with your child.

dialogue.origin: 子どもに対してはとても優しくていいお父さんだと思います
dialogue.content: He's very kind to our child; I think he's a good father.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの面倒をよく見てくれるのですね
dialogue.content: So he takes good care of your child.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, he does.

dialogue.origin: ご主人はどんな人柄でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What kind of person is your husband?

dialogue.origin: 物静かな人です。
dialogue.content: He’s a quiet person.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: だけど、女の人がとにかく大好きで…
dialogue.content: But... he just really loves women.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですよね・・
dialogue.content: That must be hard for you…

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなときにそのように思うのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: When do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: イベントとかに行くと必ず女の人と写真と撮ったり、フェイスブックとかは女友達しかいなかったり…
dialogue.content: When we go to events, he always takes pictures with women, and on Facebook, he only seems to have female friends...

dialogue.origin: 飲み会は絶対女の子がいないと行かないとか
dialogue.content: He won’t go to a drinking party unless there are girls there.

dialogue.origin: それもキレイなお姉さんが好きで困ります
dialogue.content: And he prefers pretty women, which is a problem for me.

dialogue.origin: いいおっさんなのに…
dialogue.content: Even though he’s old enough to know better…

dialogue.origin: そんなことが・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 毎回だと悲しくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It must be sad for you when that happens every time.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 前は何度かやめてと伝えたこともあったんですが、喧嘩になってしまうので最近はもう言うのはやめました
dialogue.content: I've asked him to stop a few times before, but it always turns into a fight, so I've stopped saying anything recently.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・それは言いづらくなりますよね…
dialogue.content: I see… That would make it hard to bring up.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 諦めてはいます
dialogue.content: I've resigned myself to it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: このことをだれかに相談されていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.origin: 誰にもいえず…
dialogue.content: I haven’t been able to tell anyone…

dialogue.origin: 今日初めて話しました
dialogue.content: This is the first time I’ve talked about it.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・
dialogue.content: I see…

dialogue.origin: なかなか言いづらいですよね
dialogue.content: It’s not easy to talk about, is it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 今回だけではなく、何回もあったとおっしゃっていましたが、それについてはどう思われますか？お話できる範囲で大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: You mentioned it’s happened not just this time but several times. How do you feel about that? Please share only as much as you’re comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: はい。初めて発覚したときはパソコンに浮気相手と一緒にいた写真がありました
dialogue.content: Okay. The first time I found out, there were pictures on his computer of him with the other woman.

dialogue.origin: そんなことが・・・
dialogue.content: You found pictures...

dialogue.origin: それはびっくりしてしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.content: That must have been a terrible shock...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。初めてだったので本当にビックリしましたけど
dialogue.content: Yes. Since it was the first time, I was truly shocked.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: とりあえず、そのときは話し合いをして終わりました
dialogue.content: For the time being, we talked it out and that was the end of it.

dialogue.origin: 夫が認めて謝った感じです
dialogue.content: My husband admitted it and apologized.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・
dialogue.content: I see…

dialogue.origin: それでも悲しくなりますよね…
dialogue.content: Even so, that must make you sad, doesn't it...

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間ですね終了いたしましょうか？
dialogue.content: It looks like our time is about up. Shall we end here for today?

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Take care.
